mapper.sql: r.*, g.title AS goods_title, g.images AS goods_image, b.nickname AS buyer_name, s.nickname AS seller_name
FROM `refund` r LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN `goods` g ON g.id = o.goods_id LEFT JOIN `user` b ON b.id = r.buyer_id LEFT JOIN `user` s ON s.id = r.seller_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE r.status = 3 ORDER BY r.arbitrate_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `refund` (order_id, order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, amount, reason, images, status, deadline) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{images}, 0, #{deadline})
mapper.update: UPDATE `refund` SET status = 1, seller_respond_time = #{respondTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE `refund` SET status = 2, seller_reply = #{reply}, seller_respond_time = #{respondTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE `refund` SET status = 3, arbitrate_time = #{arbitrateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2
UPDATE `refund` SET status = 4, admin_note = #{note}, admin_respond_time = #{respondTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3
UPDATE `refund` SET status = 5, admin_note = #{note}, admin_respond_time = #{respondTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3
UPDATE `refund` SET status = 6, refund_time = #{refundTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (1, 4)
